Structured data checker

Enter a page URL to find its JSON-LD structured data and check the basics.

What this checks

Reads the JSON-LD blocks, checks the JSON is valid and looks for the main required properties of common types.

How to fix common problems

  • Fix invalid JSON first, because Google ignores broken blocks.
  • Fill every required property for the type you use.
  • Only mark up content that is visible on the page.

Common questions

What is JSON-LD?

A way to add structured data to a page so search engines understand its content.

Does this replace Google's Rich Results Test?

No. It is a quick basic check. Use Google's tool to confirm eligibility for rich results.
